intro: Add your AI character as an OBS Browser Source. Audio, lipsync, and avatar rendering run entirely inside OBS — no virtual cable or extra software required.

model.label: 3D model uploaded
model.warn: Go to Avatars tab and upload a VRM, GLB, or Live2D model

channel.label: Platform channel linked
channel.warn: Go to Connection tab and link a Discord, Twitch, or other channel

channelSelect: Route audio from this channel into OBS

url.incomplete: Complete the requirements above to generate your OBS URL.

1.title: Add a Browser Source
1.desc: In OBS, click Sources → + and choose Browser.

2.title: Paste the URL and enable transparency
2.desc: Paste the URL above. Check Allow transparency. Set width/height to match your avatar (e.g. 800 × 900 px).
